meta.name: meta-tags-optimizer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "optimize meta tags"; improves titles, descriptions, Open Graph, Twitter cards, and CTR test variants. Not for JSON-LD structured data — use schema-markup-generator; not for body copy — use seo-content-writer. 标题优化/元描述/CTR

copy.tagline: 优化网页标题和描述以提升点击率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要改善网页在搜索结果中的表现
copy.tagline_en: Optimize page titles and descriptions to boost click-through rates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to improve your web pages' performance in search results

howto.what: Claude 会为网页生成标题、描述、Open Graph 和 Twitter 卡片等元标签，并提供 3 个标题和 3 个描述选项，同时给出点击率优化建议。
howto.when: 当你要求“优化元标签”或“改善这些元标签的点击率”时触发。

say.text: 帮我优化这个页面的元标签：https://example.com
say.note: Claude 会分析页面并生成优化后的标签。

say.text: 为关于“健康饮食”的页面生成标题和描述
say.note: Claude 会提供 3 个标题和 3 个描述选项。

say.text: 改善这些元标签的点击率：当前标题是...
say.note: Claude 会给出优化建议和 A/B 测试方案。

howto.what_en: Claude generates title tags, meta descriptions, Open Graph and Twitter Card tags for a page, providing three title and three description options along with CTR optimization tips.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'optimize meta tags' or 'improve these meta tags for better CTR'.

say_en.text: Optimize meta tags for this page: https://example.com
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the page and generates optimized tags.

say_en.text: Generate title and description for a page about 'healthy eating'
say_en.note: Claude provides three title and three description options.

say_en.text: Improve these meta tags for better CTR: current title is...
say_en.note: Claude gives optimization tips and A/B test options.
